_about: Real grasp, right wrist camera, 13 grasps 2026-11-02 (docs/real/INHAND_REAL.md). Deltas about the Part 1 nominal on the TCP axes, the median over grasps; roll about the reader axis set to 0 (flat reader, level hand, below what this camera resolves); y follows from the pads centring the reader (envs/inhand_real.reader_in_site). Position in the runtime camera frame (tip_offset_target=camera): image-true. half_range = 2 SD over grasps. render_lateral_mm: image offset kept for rendering only.
